If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is rising, cap late horizon (15–30 days) at +1.0% above recent peak to prevent runaway inflation.

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for mid horizon (8–14 days) to counteract pessimism-induced underestimation.

If sentiment is >0.67 and true outcome exceeds forecast by >2.0%, adjust next forecast down by 0.5–1.0% to reflect sentiment-driven momentum correction.

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is above true outcome, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon (15–30 days) to align with bearish sentiment.

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is below true outcome, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid sentiment overcorrection.
